scope: single-Mother trial for large standalone HTML whose primary payload can delay or fail independently of the document shell
trigger: a final-ready browser test can pass while a real user reports a blank or white initial page
assertions: final runtime readiness does not prove the page painted useful content before the primary payload completed
the test must hold the main response before the primary payload and observe a painted visible shell within a bounded time
DOM source order or a final screenshot alone is insufficient early-visibility evidence
a truncated response must produce a visible error state rather than a silent blank page
runtime capability failure must expose visible recovery or rollback without weakening final-ready tests
a user-visible failure rejects the stronger user-visible claim but does not erase separately valid artifact-integrity or final-ready evidence
user-device repair and original root cause remain Unknown until independently verified
